shortDescription: Jeffrey Kaplan’s first job at his father’s kosher pickle company in New Jersey was learning to drive a forklift without leaving a mess on the warehouse floor, according to Bloomberg.The profile traces Kaplan’s path from that early job to sports banking and the NFL’s Seattle Seahawks.
